title: SIIL SAMMI JA ORAV OLLE TEEVAD LAEVA

characters.name: SIIL SAMMI
characters.description: Väike siil, seljas palju pehmeid pruune okkaid, kaelas roheline kootud sall, jalas kollased kummikud. Ilma kampsunita. Suured uudishimulikud mustad silmad ja armas naeratus. Armas ja soe multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ORAV OLLE
characters.description: Väike oranž orav suure koheva oravasabaga, ilma triipudeta ja ilma prillideta, kandmas siniseid traksipükse. Rõõmsameelne näoilme, suured säravad silmad ja ümarad kõrvatutid. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Puidust tööriistakuur
locations.description: Cozy rustic wooden garden shed with warm wooden walls, a small wooden workbench on the left, a single window on the back wall showing red and yellow autumn leaves outside, wooden plank floor, warm natural lighting indoors. Clean cartoon style.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with a large shallow rainwater puddle in the center on green grass, colorful red and yellow autumn leaves scattered on the ground, bright blue sky, cozy wooden garden fence in the background. Clean cartoon style.

pages.scene: Siil Sammi wearing a green scarf and yellow boots, and Orav Olle in blue overalls stand together inside a cozy wooden garden shed. They are near a small wooden workbench. On the workbench are small wood scraps. Sammi and Olle look at each other with happy smiling expressions. Sunlight streams through the back window showing orange autumn leaves outside. Siil Sammi is a hedgehog with soft brown quills, a green knitted scarf and yellow rubber boots, no sweater. Orav Olle is a red squirrel (not a cat) with a big bushy squirrel tail without stripes, no glasses, wearing blue overalls. The wooden shed floor is painted in full detail all the way down to the very bottom edge of the picture, like the top of the picture.

Siil Sammi gently shapes a small wooden toy boat body on the wooden workbench. Orav Olle stands beside him holding a smooth wooden stick, looking excited. The garden shed has warm wooden walls, the workbench, and a back window with autumn trees visible. Siil Sammi is a hedgehog with soft brown quills, a green knitted scarf and yellow rubber boots, no sweater. Orav Olle himself, with his own paws, carefully attaches a bright yellow autumn leaf as a sail to the stick mast on the small wooden toy boat resting on the workbench. Siil Sammi is a hedgehog with soft brown quills, a green knitted scarf and yellow rubber boots, no sweater.
